TVS Credit · EPIC 8 · Analytics Case Study 1

Residual Intelligence Console

Loading model and holdout book…
How this works. The production model is a Random Forest trained on 9,767 agreements liquidated Apr–Dec 2025 and tested on 5,233 from Jan–Jul 2026. For this console it is distilled into a gradient-boosted surrogate small enough to run client-side (). No data leaves the page.

Leakage discipline. Every input on the Deal tab is known at origination. Asset condition, months in yard and outstanding balance at liquidation are deliberately excluded — they are not observable when the loan is sanctioned, and they power the separate recovery-desk model on its own tab.
